fields.label: Function Name
fields.description: The tool name the AI calls. Letters, numbers and underscores only, e.g. get_customer_balance.

fields.label: Type
fields.options:
Get Document
Get Multiple Documents
Get List
Get Value
Create Document
Create Multiple Documents
Update Document
Update Multiple Documents
Delete Document
Delete Multiple Documents
Submit Document
Cancel Document
Get Amended Document
Set Value
Attach File to Document
Get Report Result
Custom Function

fields.label: Requires Write Permissions
fields.description: Set automatically for create/update/delete/submit/cancel/set-value/attach. Write functions only run for users with the Support AI write role (see Support AI Settings).

fields.label: Reference DocType
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:!["Custom Function", "Get Report Result", "Attach File to Document"].includes(doc.type)

fields.label: Function Path
fields.description: Dotted path to a @frappe.whitelist()-ed Python function, e.g. my_app.api.get_stock_summary

fields.label: Pass Parameters as JSON
fields.description: Call the function with one JSON string argument instead of keyword arguments.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Tell the AI exactly when to use this function and what it returns.

fields.label: Access
fields.description: Optional extra restriction on top of normal DocType permissions.

fields.label: Allowed Roles
fields.description: If set, only users with at least one of these roles can run this function.

fields.label: Parameters
fields.description: For Create/Update these are the document fields the AI fills. For Get List / Get Report Result they become filters. For Custom Function they are the keyword arguments.

fields.label: Strict Schema
fields.description: Do not allow parameters other than the ones listed.
